source: Files actually downloaded from the live website run (Conservative mode, realistic_candidate fixtures), not locally generated.

pdf.defect: Section order did not match the delivered markdown: Technical Skills was emitted before Education and Certifications. Root cause: main_template.tex placed the % TECHNICAL SKILLS slot before % EDUCATION, and render_template replaced slots in that physical order. The DOCX kept the markdown order, so the two exports of one run disagreed.
pdf.status: FIXED in this session; regression tests added.

docx.defect: Section headings carry the 'Normal' paragraph style, so the DOCX has no outline/navigation structure and no heading semantics for screen readers or Word's navigation pane.
docx.status: OPEN - reported, not fixed in this session.

content_observations.judgment: CORRECT - the source fixtures contain no projects. An empty heading is the honest representation; nothing was invented to fill it.

content_observations.observation: Technical Skills lists four lines with overlapping items (thermographic inspection, NFPA 70E, lockout/tagout appear twice)
content_observations.judgment: FAITHFUL - the two source files each carry their own Skills block with exactly these four lines. The duplication is in the source, not introduced by the pipeline.

content_observations.observation: DOCX shows literal '--' where the PDF renders an en dash
content_observations.judgment: COSMETIC - normalize_dash maps en/em dash to '--' for LaTeX, which typesets it as an en dash; the DOCX writes the same '--' literally. Same content, different typography.

post_fix_verification.source: Files downloaded from a second live website run (Conservative, same fixtures).
post_fix_verification.verdict: Both exports now emit the six sections in REQUIRED_HEADINGS order and agree with each other. The PDF order defect is closed.
